description: This Java source file defines a public interface for responses related to connectivity commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies methods for retrieving connection identifiers, resource paths, and headers, as well as a nested class for JSON field definitions related to connectivity command responses.

classes.name: ConnectivityCommandResponse.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains definitions for JSON fields specific to ConnectivityCommandResponse, notably the connectionId field.

methods.name: getConnectionId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the connection as a string, deprecated in favor of getConnectionEntityId().

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ConnectionId object representing the connection's identifier.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Overrides to return the connection entity ID as the entity identifier.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JsonPointer for resource location.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string for connectivity commands.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets Ditto headers for the response object.
